searchText: Week 10 is here! Hope you are all doing well and got some great updates going on. Please share your latest news! Hey <@686695036733227017> , I'm Anmol, want to join the EPF permissionless track. But I'm pretty late, and I saw that the presentation stage is over. Is there any way I can still start with a project/or join in on existing projects? I had a look through the project ideas in the repo, and I really found the idea from EthPandaOps from their wishlist interesting, It's about creating tooling for GPU profiling as the upcoming zkvms are supposedly being run in GPU for performance. Apart from this, I also found the reth as a project interesting cause I've experience writing Rust and have built p2p systems using libp2p. But the open project ideas from reth seems to be already taken, is there any way maybe I can pair with other fellows for the projects or have another project in the reth. The repository suggests that we can do our own suggested project as long as it's valuable to the client team. It'd be really helpful if you could point me to where I can find the roadmap items that the team care about?

But the open project ideas from reth seems to be already taken, is there any way maybe I can pair with other fellows for the projects or have another project in the reth.
